description: Source: RISEx. Read-only keyless perp reads: health, markets, fundingSnapshot (coins up to 20 from the reviewed TxFlow/RISEx mapping), book (coin, depth up to 20), fundingHistory (market, limit up to 1000, pages up to 5). Funding normalized to decimal/hour; raw string kept. Book time is not published and stays unknown. Hosted disabled by default.

coins.description: Reviewed mapped coins, e.g. BTC; unmapped coins are refused
